name: vnkvm
description: Use the Mac's mouse and keyboard like a person: human-like cursor paths, typing rhythm, screen and window screenshots, over MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Human-like mouse and keyboard control of macOS.
interface.longDescription: A software KVM for macOS. Moves the cursor along human-like paths, types with human rhythm, and captures the screen or a single app window, with both global and window-relative coordinates. Stops when you grab the mouse.
